answer.answer: Ujjwala 2.0 provides special facility to migrant households [E01], with an additional allocation of 1.6 Crore LPG connections under the scheme [E01]. The predecessor Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY), launched in May 2016, established a clean-cooking transition by providing free LPG connections to women from below-poverty-line households to replace traditional cooking fuels such as firewood, coal, and cow-dung cakes [E02]. This shift helped reduce health risks for women and minimize environmental pollution [E01].
